testcase.name: Scenario: Navigate adjacent part templates with arrow keys: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-document-creation-navigation-source/features/application/document-creation/document-creation-navigation-native.feature:26:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate adjacent part templates with arrow keys ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-navigation-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And its Metric folder contains exactly the four named native part templates used below ✔> And its English folder contains the standard inch part template ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the new-document chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons ✔ And the part group displays Sheet Metal (mm) immediately before Standard (DIN) ✔ When the user selects the Sheet Metal (mm) part template ✔ Then its tile is selected and its details identify millimeter units ✔ When the user presses Right ✔ Then the Standard (DIN) part tile is selected ✔ And the details identify Standard (DIN) and millimeter units ✔ When the user presses Left ✔ Then the Sheet Metal (mm) part tile is selected again ✔ And its sheet-metal details are displayed ✔ When the user presses Down ✔ Then the template gallery scrolls down ✔ And Sheet Metal (mm) remains selected with its details displayed ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the chooser closes and the original part remains active
